integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained once the focal source's infinite-kernel characterization of the upper semi-Fredholm radius is used. No finite experiment, unverified numerical optimization, or independence claim is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives only the obstruction contributed by complemented Hilbertian subspaces and does not determine the full upper semi-Fredholm comparison invariant in general.
It does not settle the conjectured equivalence with uniform subprojectivity or equality with the uniform-subprojectivity invariant.
A residual originality risk remains for older equivalent formulations under different semi-Fredholm terminology.
title: Sharp coefficient-one Hilbertian obstruction for the upper semi-Fredholm comparison constant
